snippet.title: 『MONOWAVE』 Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
MONOWAVE is a whimsical and thrilling puzzle-action adventure game about the power of emotions, releasing September 16 on Steam and Nintendo Switch!

🎮 Steam Page (Add it to your Wishlist!)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680440/MONOWAVE/

🕹️ Free Demo Available on Steam (Play up to the first boss!)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2981010/_Demo/
